draft.emotion: a sense of quiet awe while looking at the night sky
notes: Standalone 月 is read 'tsuki'. In month names it is read '-gatsu' (e.g., 一月 ichigatsu, January), and when counting months it uses '-kagetsu' (e.g., 二ヶ月 nikagetsu, two months).
The moon in the sky is often politely or affectionately called お月様 (otsuki-sama), especially with children.
